_meta.note: A pattern list of domain SHAPES that are never a real published tuning domain -- never a domain allowlist (an allowlist of ~100+ real domains is a population that grows every time a program adds one, exactly the kind of number the contract-not-population rule forbids pinning). Closed vocabulary: a new pattern is a reviewed change, added only when a new class of test/tooling pollution is found writing into data/tuning/.
